svg.title: Simulation Guide Drag Overlays
svg.desc: Editable SVG sheet of the draggable simulation guide overlays rendered on the canvas, including spawn, spawn blob, attract and repel points, path guide handles, overlay chips, edge barriers, pheromone trails, and in-progress drawing previews.

g.text: Canvas-facing guide primitives and handles from drawSimulationOverlay, exported separately from the inspector sheet.
Selected spawn with radius handle and spawn chip.
Mask-based spawn preview. No radius handle when mask exists.
Selected blob gets no radius handle
Both point guides expose a radius handle and a vertical strength handle.
Selected boid path with pathPosition, start, direction, scale, closed, speed, and radius handles plus stacked action chips.
Action stack flips above or below path bounds
Green handles = start / direction / scale / speed
Gold circle = path position drag handle
These are draggable by the polyline itself; they do not expose the boid path handle set.
Thin line + translucent avoidance radius stroke.
Rounded thick stroke. Drag the trail path itself.
Shown while drawing path or edge guides before commit.
Dashed thick preview uses current pheromone radius.
Direct export of the preview semantics from BlobStroke.renderPreview: filled ribbon, stroke path, and dashed bounds.
Primitive shapes used by the draggable overlay targets.

Source surfaces: [app.js](app.js#L6591) handle generation, [app.js](app.js#L7071) path overlay chip placement, [app.js](app.js#L11156) overlay drawing, and [blob-stroke.js](blob-stroke.js#L377) blob preview rendering.
The earlier inspector-oriented [simulation_guides_ui.svg](simulation_guides_ui.svg) file is unchanged; this sheet isolates only the draggable canvas overlay elements.
